name: popsicle
headline: Marketing Analytics: Unified Data Warehouse & ETL
short_description: This repository features my project as a Business Analytics Intern at Limitless Marketing, a Canadian digital marketing agency. To solve the challenge of fragmented data, I built an end-to-end analytics solution with a unified data warehouse, ETL pipelines, and real-time dashboards, driving impactful, data-driven insights for the agency’s clients.
author: Grisales1803

sections.overview:
This skill demonstrates how to design and implement a complete marketing analytics infrastructure, from data consolidation to actionable insights. It covers building a centralized data warehouse in Snowflake, automating data ingestion from sources like Facebook Ads, ClickFunnels, ConvertKit, and Typeform using tools like Zapier, Fivetran, and n8n, and creating real-time dashboards in Power BI and Looker Studio. The project solves the challenge of fragmented marketing data across multiple platforms by establishing a single source of truth, enabling data-driven decision-making for marketing agencies and their clients. Technical implementation includes SQL query optimization, ETL pipeline automation, semantic modeling, and dashboard design to answer key business questions about conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and campaign performance.
Consolidating multi-source marketing data into a centralized data warehouse
Automating daily data ingestion from ad platforms and lead capture tools
Building interactive dashboards for real-time campaign performance monitoring
Calculating key marketing metrics like cost per purchase and conversion rates
